result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I compiled it (`mvn -q -o compile`) but didn't run any tests. No existing test references this method, and I didn't add one.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses. I also updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged (highest count first, then name, then id).
